post.summary: Slots of one person on one date with the free eligible staff per slot (a read; POST because of the body)
post.description: Ask once per person; send the times the earlier persons picked in `others` so the same staff member is not offered twice. `reason` explains a day without slots: PAST, TOO_FAR or CLOSED. A slot is available when at least one eligible staff member is free for the whole duration (existing PENDING/APPROVED bookings and live payment holds count as busy).

post.summary: Validate and price a booking (summary step), hold the slots for `booking.paymentHoldMinutes` and snapshot prices and the salon policy. Replaces the customer’s earlier draft.
post.description: Persons are checked in order and each pick blocks the next. Errors (422): SALON_NOT_BOOKABLE, TOO_MANY_COMPANIONS, GENDER_MISMATCH, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, BRIDE_ONLY_SERVICE, STAFF_NOT_ELIGIBLE, SALON_CLOSED, DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE, SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, PAYMENT_OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED.

post.summary: Confirm the booking with the OTP (purpose BOOKING_CONFIRMATION): the Firebase ID token must belong to the customer’s own phone. Required before the booking is created.
Create the booking from a confirmed draft (status PENDING, waits for the salon). Deposit and full-payment drafts are created from their verified payment (the booking then shows the paid amounts).
post.description: Needs the draft’s OTP confirmation (`verify-otp`), else 422 `OTP_INVALID`. The slots are re-validated under a lock per staff member and date: a slot that went away answers 409 `SLOT_TAKEN`. An expired draft is 422 `DRAFT_EXPIRED`; an online draft needs a verified payment (SUCCEEDED, exact amount, not used before) else 422 `PAYMENT_NOT_VERIFIED`; when the slot went away after payment the whole payment is refunded at once and the answer is 409 `SLOT_TAKEN`.

post.description: The draft must be unexpired and OTP-confirmed with an online payment option (else 422 `DRAFT_EXPIRED` / `OTP_INVALID` / `PAYMENT_OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED`). A running or successful attempt is returned again; after a failed or cancelled one a new attempt starts. The booking itself is created afterwards, only from a verified payment.
